🎯 Purpose.what: What this Theme contributes to the Project mission.
🎯 Purpose.example: hai-project owns the Project; the Theme owner supplies its contribution.

🧭 Plan.what: How this Theme intends to make its contribution.
🧭 Plan.layout: Ordered proposed steps. The Blocks section opens the source work; step-to-Block bindings are not assigned in this preview.
🧭 Plan.example: The Theme owner defines the plan. The preview shows proposed sequences, not commissioned work.

🗂️ Themes.example: hai-project owns the boundary. Project is above Themes.

🧱 Blocks.what: The Blocks carrying out the selected Theme’s plan.
🧱 Blocks.layout: Block goal and recorded state, opening the source Block.
🧱 Blocks.example: The preview links existing Work Blocks (Blueprint); it does not invent their state.

🔗 Handoffs.what: Inputs from other Themes and outputs this Theme supplies.
🔗 Handoffs.layout: Producer → artifact → consumer, with its recorded state.
🔗 Handoffs.example: hai-delivery and the producer/consumer contracts own the records; missing bindings remain unbound.

🎨 Studio.example: hai-studio; Themes aggregate Block topics and create no Theme-local Studio.

⚖️ Decisions.example: hai-studio; proposals are never shown as agreed.

🧰 Skills.what: The owning skills for this view.
🧰 Skills.layout: Links to the actual skill files.
🧰 Skills.example: Each Theme’s owner and workbench contract, plus hai-project for the Project.
